$comment: Which changelog entries the automatic X lane (api/_lib/changelog-push.js, pushXLane) must never post. Telegram is unaffected. An entry is skipped when it carries a blocked tag, carries none of the required tags, or when its title or summary matches any pattern (case-insensitive regular expressions). Every rule records why, so removing one is a decision, not a guess. Project names the owner gated in data/announce-gate-terms.json are blocked here too.

blockedTags.security: Security work is described on the changelog page, never advertised on a public feed.

requireAnyTag.reason: Bare fixes and infra or docs-only entries read as outage notes or plumbing, not as something a reader can use.

patterns.reason: Agent and platform wallet operations (funding, signing, pools) are sensitive on a public feed.
Reliability admissions belong on the changelog page.
Real-money risk, or copy that reads as advice to lower a protection.
$THREE is the only coin the account promotes.
Posts about our own posting machinery.
